import sys

class TaskA:
    def solve(self, testNumber, in_reader, out):
        str_input = in_reader.next()
        left = 0
        result = 0
        while left < len(str_input):
            end = left + 1
            while end < len(str_input) and str_input[left] == str_input[end]:
                end += 1
            
            result += (end - left + 1) % 2
            left = end
        
        out.println(result)

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, input_stream):
        self.reader = input_stream
    
    def next(self):
        return self.reader.readline().rstrip('\n')

def main():
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    output_stream = sys.stdout
    in_reader = InputReader(input_stream)
    out = output_stream
    solver = TaskA()
    solver.solve(1, in_reader, out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
